_doc: Every value the Arkiv demo shows, and where it comes from. Nothing here is invented: no entity key, tx hash or address exists until the event, so none is shown. RIA = the shipped Marine Drive GP test log (WSL /opt/arca-sandbox/devicecheck/MDGP.acl, made by device/make_testlogs.py; header ACL1 MDGP, rules 4, seed 0, 6461 frames, hash 225D59FD); its SHA-256 by sha256sum on 2026-11-05. YOU = the real slower run prep/make_handler_run.py played and arcade_replay replayed (public/handler/run.json). The forged row's time is not a run: it is the look-alike row the demo writes from a stranger's wallet, labelled FORGED on screen.
